Sets the quality of the generated JPEG images. Must be an integer between 0 and 100. Default: 80.

## CLI flag

```text
--jpeg-quality <value>
```

The following CLI commands accept this option:

- [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)
- [`remotion render`](/docs/cli/render)
- [`remotion still`](/docs/cli/still)
- [`remotion benchmark`](/docs/cli/benchmark)
- [`remotion lambda render`](/docs/lambda/cli/render)
- [`remotion lambda still`](/docs/lambda/cli/still)
- [`remotion cloudrun render`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/render)
- [`remotion cloudrun still`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/still)

## APIs that have this option

The following APIs accept this option:

- [`renderMediaOnCloudrun()`](/docs/cloudrun/rendermediaoncloudrun#jpegquality)
- [`renderStillOnCloudrun()`](/docs/cloudrun/renderstilloncloudrun#jpegquality)
- [`renderMediaOnLambda()`](/docs/lambda/rendermediaonlambda#jpegquality)
- [`renderStillOnLambda()`](/docs/lambda/renderstillonlambda#jpegquality)
- [`renderFrames()`](/docs/renderer/render-frames#jpegquality)
- [`renderMedia()`](/docs/renderer/render-media#jpegquality)
- [`renderStill()`](/docs/renderer/render-still#jpegquality)

## Config file

```ts twoslash title="remotion.config.ts"
import {Config} from '@remotion/cli/config';
// ---cut---
Config.setJpegQuality(90);
```
